task: diagnose the Web-plane failure `DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON` and explain why the Docker real-machine lane never caught it
userRequestVerbatim: 该plugin在web界面运行时报错：DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON,完全无法运行，我不知道docker实机验证为什么没验出来，给我一个原因，再出方案修改
verdict: NOT a plugin-code defect. The DeepSeek model streamed one syntactically invalid tool-call argument; the harness classifies that as MALFORMED_RESPONSE, MALFORMED_RESPONSE is absent from the provider's default retryableCodes, so dsh-llm-retry declines and the agent loop aborts the whole turn. The Docker lane never observed it because its only model-dependent assertion (boot.llmTurn) recorded null in every recorded run — no credential was staged, so no model token was ever produced.

failingSubject.surface: Web GUI session — the user message arrived with an rpcId and clientTimeZone (Asia/Shanghai)
failingSubject.parseError: Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 586 (line 1 column 587)
failingSubject.offendingBytes: 让\"这条依赖链"与非链边"一眼可分。 — the OPENING quote is escaped (\\\"), the CLOSING quote is a bare ASCII 0x22, which terminates the JSON string early
failingSubject.offendingCodepoints: closing quote U+0022 at the reported offset; surrounded by CJK U+4F9D U+8D56 U+94FE / U+4E0E U+975E

error.message: DeepSeek Messages stream: tool input is invalid JSON

failingSubject.collateral: two background subagents (d166cce4-a012-405b-9ca0-93b2e05febb6, dd1c9e0d-4f39-4088-96df-2ef48792dbac) were started at step 51 and orphaned when step 52 aborted the turn

rootCauseChain: dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js `translate()` — at `message_stop` it JSON.parse()s every tool-call block's accumulated `input_json_delta` text (the block.json accumulation happens at the `content_block_stop` branch: `if (block.content.type === "tool-call" && block.json.length > 0) block.content.arguments = block.json`).
A JSON.parse throw there becomes `malformed("tool input is invalid JSON")` -> `new LlmError(..., "MALFORMED_RESPONSE")`.
The error reaches the agent loop; dsh-llm-retry's `recover()` listener reads `payload.retryPolicy` and does `else if (!policy.retryableCodes.includes(failure.code)) return next();`.
DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES in @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm is Object.freeze([EMPTY_RESPONSE, RATE_LIMIT, SERVER, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT]) — MALFORMED_RESPONSE is NOT in it.
No listener returns {kind:'retry'} => the step is not re-attempted => the turn ends with reason.kind='error'. One unescaped byte costs the entire turn.
MALFORMED_RESPONSE is referenced ONLY inside dsh-llm-deepseek (5 sites) — no other harness package classifies, retries or repairs it (grep over all @deepseek-ai packages).

triggerPressure.note: the model was asked to emit a deeply nested CJK JSON inside a request already carrying >160 KB of prompt + 73 KB of tool schema

whyDockerMissedIt.mechanism: opt-in: the step only runs when the caller stages DEEPSEEK_API_KEY (`docker compose run -e DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`); otherwise it records `null` with reason 'not attempted: a live LLM turn needs provider credentials and this container stages none'
whyDockerMissedIt.observed: every recorded Docker run reports boot.llmTurn = null
structuralReasons: The 52-58 passing assertions are composition/mount/HTTP facts (rows applied, tools registered, HTTP 200, POST /api/session/create -> agentPreset=mpd, TUI on a real PTY). None of them reads a model-emitted tool argument, so the class is invisible to them by construction.

The defect exists only INSIDE an SSE stream, before any durable record — and the harness aborts before committing the assistant message, so even the session store keeps no tool/call record for it (measured: 2962 recorded tool calls across this workspace, 0 malformed arguments, while exactly 1 turn died of this error).

Even with a key staged, the live arm runs `dsh --profile headless` (docker/entrypoint.sh step 13) — not the `web` profile the user runs — with a three-sentence English prompt whose verdict is a FILESYSTEM artifact (a .mpd/team/teams/*.json record after an approve). A long, deeply nested, CJK-quoted tool argument is not reachable from that prompt.
Net: install+mount green does NOT imply a model turn survives. The lane proves the plugin is MOUNTED, never that it RAN a turn.

reproducer.whyAssistantAttempt: the audit MUST read `assistant/attempt` stream records, not `tool/call` records — the abort discards the call, so a tool/call audit reports zero findings on a session that actually died
reproducer.observed: scanned 30 session container(s); malformed tool input: 1; terminal turn failures: 3

retryInsteadOfAbort.plumbing: dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml declares the row `id: llm-deepseek` (name @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key); that plugin registers the provider with settingsNs = the row id and settingsPath = [] (dsh-llm-deepseek-api-key/lib/index.js:52-57), so the `llm-deepseek:` settings section reaches the same Config, which includes retryPolicy (deepSeekConfigFields).
retryInsteadOfAbort.bundleConstraint: the bundle may NOT id-target that row — cordis.patch.yml:4-6 states the policy and scripts/verify-no-host-override.ts enforces it dynamically. The settings plane is the route.
retryInsteadOfAbort.retrySafety: the failed attempt produced nothing durable — the abort happens at message_stop, before `finish`, so the assistant message is never committed and no tool was dispatched. This is exactly the harness's own stated reason for making EMPTY_RESPONSE retryable by default.

bundleOwnedAlternatively.seam: mpd-dsh-adapter `onEvent(event, handler)` forwards ctx.on (capabilities().events); dsh-llm-retry's own listener proves `agent/request-error` is a waterfall whose return value decides
bundleOwnedAlternatively.caveat: a bundle-owned listener returning {kind:'retry'} bypasses the host retry plugin's counters/backoff unless it delegates via next(); it needs its own bounded counter.

fixLevers.promptMitigation: mpd registers prompt sections through the adapter (registerPromptSection); a JSON-hygiene rule for tool-argument string values (no bare ASCII quote inside a CJK value) reduces the trigger rate.
fixLevers.upstreamAsk: classify MALFORMED_RESPONSE as retryable by default in @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm, and/or salvage the malformed argument payload; the tool with the most free-form CJK text (ask_user_question) is a host tool the bundle cannot reshape.

gatesToRunForTheFix: bun run verify:docs (the fix adds a doc pair)
node scripts/docker-e2e.ts --mode source --require-docker (and oneclick) — plus the new --require-live arm so a null boot.llmTurn cannot be reported as a pass
